headline: A 2022 law renames a Winchester, Virginia Postal Service facility the Patsy Cline Post Office.
what_it_does: This law names a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 132 North Loudoun Street in Winchester, Virginia, as the Patsy Cline Post Office. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or what it costs. Patsy Cline was a well-known country singer from Winchester.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 24, 2022.
